scientific_integrity: The general IC/live-edge model and path optimization algorithms are credited as prior knowledge. The assertion is an analytical all-sizes monotone threshold theorem, checked computationally but not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Finite undirected paths, exactly two fixed seeds, homogeneous independent Bernoulli edge transmission; no heterogeneous, directed, cyclic, or higher-seed extension. Directly relevant 2011 path-optimization thesis abstract accessible but full text unavailable, leaving explicit prior-coverage risk.
title: Monotone separation of optimal paired seeds on homogeneous paths
